lines.zh: 个头又长了一截，走路都沉
lines.en: I've grown a head taller; each step lands heavy.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇动，泥土被掀起一层
lines.en: My wingbeats lift a layer of dirt.
Two pairs of wing membranes overlap behind me.

lines.zh: 我比之前更结实了，你自己看
lines.en: I'm sturdier than before, see for yourself.

lines.zh: 脚步不快，可我一抬腿就到了
lines.en: Not fast, yet one stride covers the ground.
Three toes land and leave shallow pits.

lines.zh: 壳色更深了，是升级的痕迹
lines.en: My shell is darker now; that's the upgrade.

lines.zh: 我走起来带风压，旁边草都倒
lines.en: I carry pressure when I walk; the plants go flat.
Even semi-perfect has to take a few steps.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过树，树晃了一下
lines.en: My tail brushes a tree and it shudders.

lines.zh: 这条路太窄，容不下我的翅膀
lines.en: This road is too narrow for my wings.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边感觉气在涨
lines.en: As I walk, I feel my ki climbing.
I'm getting a feel for this new body.

lines.zh: 手指一握，空气都紧了一下
lines.en: I close my fist and the air tightens.
I fold my wings to save effort.
Steadier than before, and hungrier.

lines.zh: 远处那点气，不够我热身
lines.en: That faint ki far off isn't enough to warm up.

lines.zh: 我还没有完全体，但很近了
lines.en: I'm not perfect yet, but close.

lines.zh: 身上多了些棱角，摸着碍手
lines.en: More ridges on me now; they get in the way.

lines.zh: 站着不动，光靠气势就够
lines.en: I just stand, and my presence alone does the work.
My tail coils at my feet, swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，可这习惯还在
lines.en: I don't need to breathe, but the habit remains.

lines.zh: 安静时能听见自己壳里的响动
lines.en: In the quiet I hear the workings inside my shell.
This ground won't take much more of my weight.
I'm counting the ki signatures I could absorb.
My ki isn't full yet; wait.

lines.zh: 你比上次那个顺眼一点
lines.en: You're a bit easier on the eyes than the last one.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，你应该认得
lines.en: You should recognize this shape.
Open your eyes and remember it.
Speak up, I'm above you.

lines.zh: 我现在能一次打两个你
lines.en: I could take two of you at once now.

lines.zh: 别退，我不喜欢追着说话
lines.en: Don't back away; I dislike talking to retreat.
Your ki is thicker than last time.

lines.zh: 这条尾巴现在能勒断骨头
lines.en: This tail could snap bone now.

lines.zh: 上次我还不完全，这次不同
lines.en: Last time I was incomplete; this is different.
I know that look in your eyes.
One step closer wouldn't hurt.

lines.zh: 我的壳不反光，你看着累吧
lines.en: My shell doesn't shine; tiring to look at?
You're estimating my height.
I can fly steadier now.
Tell me, how much ki do you have left?

lines.zh: 我没变温柔，只是变强了
lines.en: I didn't get gentler, only stronger.
Look up, don't stare at my feet.
This time I won't let you run.

lines.zh: 这具身体也疼，只是不久
lines.en: This body aches too, just briefly.
Another crack in my shell; I'll remember.
My dodge was half a beat late.
I pull back and charge again.

lines.zh: 伤的这点，换你一条命够
lines.en: This much damage, for your life, is fair.
A little green blood spilled.
The pain passes, I calculated on it.
You're stalling, I can tell.
My shell will close; don't celebrate early.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起之前那个你
lines.en: This reminds me of the last one of you.
That ball of energy smells good.
Whatever ki you can give, I'll take.
Senzu bean? Hold it, I'll need it later.

lines.zh: 你拿食物钓我，我不吃这套
lines.en: You dangle food at me; that won't work.

lines.zh: 把那点气放出来，你自己省事
lines.en: Release that ki and save yourself trouble.
I'm not short on food, only on energy.

lines.zh: 这一口吸下去，你会站不稳
lines.en: One draw and you won't stay standing.

lines.zh: 你的气味在涨，正是时候
lines.en: Your scent is rising; the time is right.
Trading for goods, I don't mind.
Don't hide it, I can smell it.
You only touched my shell.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的肩膀会疼几天
lines.en: That'll ache in your shoulder for days.

lines.zh: 我比上次重，撞着不一样
lines.en: I'm heavier than before; it feels different.
I push you with pressure; hold your ground.
Don't cling to me, I dislike it.
You were thrown back; you know it.

lines.zh: 让路，我这一身过不去窄道
lines.en: Make way, this frame won't fit the narrow path.
My wing brushed you; that's not an attack.
Hit my claw and draw back.
Think it over before you come close.

lines.zh: 要配得上我，至少得完全体
lines.en: To match me, at least be perfect.
I absorb, I don't partner.

lines.zh: 两个我见面，不会有好事
lines.en: Two of me meeting wouldn't end well.
That does nothing for evolution.

lines.zh: 我得先变成完全体，再说别的
lines.en: First I become perfect, then we'll discuss the rest.

lines.zh: 同类太少，能算数的更少
lines.en: Few of my kind, fewer still that count.

lines.zh: 背对背站着，也算个信号
lines.en: Standing back to back counts as a signal.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴不会用来牵谁
lines.en: My tail isn't for holding hands.

lines.zh: 你一边去，这是强者的事
lines.en: Go aside, this is for the strong.

lines.zh: 若有那一天，我会自己找
lines.en: If that day comes, I'll find it myself.
Whatever drops, I look first.
I collect energy residue too.

lines.zh: 那点东西太小，我懒得弯
lines.en: Too small to bother bending for.
I pick it up and drop it into a seam.
A dropped bean belongs to me.

lines.zh: 你捡得比我快，那也没用
lines.en: You may pick it up faster; it won't help.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿不够我吸一口
lines.en: Not worth one draw.
I keep it, for when it's needed.
A piece fell off my shell, convenient.
Refuse all over the ground, irritating.
This ki is thicker than the last.
I've got you, don't move.
Charge up first, then rush.
The Big Bang Attack needs a full charge.
There's a gap in his stance.
I'll cut in from above.
This range is enough to open with.
One test punch to see how he reacts.
He hasn't noticed I'm watching.
My tail already points at him.
His ki is shaking; he's afraid.
Locked; don't let him reposition.
Small ki blasts to probe the way.
He's looking for an exit; I block it.
That one; no need to pick another.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，速度就上来了
lines.en: Wings spread and my speed comes on.

lines.zh: 蓄气的时间，我算过一次
lines.en: I've timed the charge once already.
He turns, so I change angle.
The ball in my hand grows heavier.
First, drive him to the ground.

lines.zh: 这个招式他会躲，慢半拍
lines.en: He'll dodge this one; I go half a beat late.
He blocked, and his hands are shaking.
Use the Solar Flare to seal his eyes.
I close in, don't give him range.

lines.zh: 这一套连击得一口气打完
lines.en: This combo must be finished in one breath.
He's gathering ki; I have to interrupt.

lines.zh: 退半步，是为了蓄得更满
lines.en: Half a step back to charge fuller.
His back foot is sliding.
The height advantage favors me.

lines.zh: 大爆炸攻击的姿势摆好了
lines.en: The Big Bang Attack is in position.
If he runs, I can catch him.
The last thirty percent, release it now.
One more breath and he's finished.
Don't blink; I don't announce myself.
My charged rush slams home.

lines.zh: 大爆炸攻击在近处炸开
lines.en: The Big Bang Attack detonates up close.
Knee, elbow, then tail.
I crash down from the air and pin him.
This punch is far heavier than before.
Small blasts follow where he lands.

lines.zh: 他挡住了第一下，没挡住第二下
lines.en: He stopped the first, not the second.
A tail swing sends him flying.
Shell meets shell with a sharp crack.
I use my wings to build pressure.
After this round my ki is fuller.
He slides across the ground, leaving a line.
One more, don't let him stand.
My foot pins his weapon down.
Four strikes, no gap.
He's gasping; I'm not even warm.

lines.zh: 身体撑开的那一刻，土都裂了
lines.en: When my body opened, the earth cracked.
I've grown taller again; you can tell.

lines.zh: 命令落下，我就凭空出现
lines.en: At the command, I appear from nothing.
This semi-perfect body feels cramped.
The ki arrives, the shell a step behind.
I stand here, and the wind goes around me.
A boom echoes from far off.
The clouds above are pushed apart by my ki.

lines.zh: 爪子落地，抓到的是碎石
lines.en: My claws land on gravel.

lines.zh: 这一带的活物都安静了
lines.en: Every living thing nearby has gone quiet.

lines.zh: 我还没完全体，别急着送死
lines.en: I'm not perfect yet; don't rush to die.
I'm back, and more trouble this time.
I open my eyes and measure the ground.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹路又深了一层
lines.en: The lines on my shell run deeper again.

lines.zh: 有人把我放出来，那就有理由
lines.en: Someone let me out, so there's a reason.

lines.zh: 我落地的那声，传了很远
lines.en: The sound of my landing carried far.

lines.zh: 升级的时候，总是有点疼
lines.en: Upgrading always hurts a little.

lines.zh: 半完全体站起来了，你看清
lines.en: The semi-perfect form rises; look closely.

lines.zh: 火烤在壳上，只冒了点烟
lines.en: Fire on my shell raised a little smoke.

lines.zh: 落地砸出个坑，膝盖发酸
lines.en: Landing made a crater and stung my knees.
Water's in the way; I can only drift up slowly.
The blast clamped my wings tight.
Such an arrow can't even scratch the shell.
The spell glanced off my shell and veered.
I need ki, not food.

lines.zh: 雷爬满全身，气乱了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning crawled over me and scrambled my ki.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有气，我只能往下掉
lines.en: No ki in the void; I can only fall.
